'''Dana Hunt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], was among the colonists came to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to try and start new lives. However, their homes in the [[Tularan Marsh]] were raided and destroyed by pirates, which prompted Dana to ask a passerby to deal with them.<ref name="Beyond Redemption" />
